Heritage Senior Research Fellow @SteveYates testified before the House Foreign Affairs Committee today on China’s role in the synthetic opioid supply chain that has contributed to the deaths of tens of thousands of Americans, including his daughter.

“This crisis has claimed the lives of over half a million Americans in the last decade. It’s not simply a drug issue, it’s a national security emergency.”
